Profile.Name: Jobify
Profile.Profile: Jobify is a self-hosted job application tracker. Keep every posting, status, interview and follow-up in one place, import jobs from LinkedIn, Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and other job sites, chart your search as a timeline or flow diagram, and optionally use an AI provider for summaries, cover letters and interview prep. Free and open source under the AGPL.
